definition: The task of identifying and classifying the semantic relationships between entities mentioned in text.
details: Relation extraction is often paired with entity extraction to automatically construct or populate knowledge graphs from unstructured documents.

explainer.lead: It identifies the semantic relationships between entities mentioned in text and classifies them. Paired with entity extraction, it automatically constructs or populates knowledge graphs from unstructured documents.

tiers.eli5: It reads a document and notes how the named things are connected, then writes those connections down as simple records.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers pair it with entity extraction to emit triples into a graph store. The pitfall is that relations spanning sentences or expressed implicitly are often missed.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, map text to a set of triples (subject, relation, object) drawn from a fixed relation inventory. Limits: distant supervision and annotation noise, plus difficulty with nested and implicit relations.

explainer.example: From 'The Eiffel Tower stands in Paris', it extracts (Eiffel Tower, located-in, Paris).
